name: marketing-room
description: The Marketing Room: an agency war room for any marketing brief. Specialist seats propose, challenge each other through dealt lenses, negotiate every conflict, and a Project Head ships one integrated plan.

interface.shortDescription: An agency war room that debates a brief and ships one plan
interface.longDescription: Give it a client brief. A Project Head casts the specialist seats, each seat proposes on its own, they challenge each other through dealt lenses, a script checks budgets, learning phases, tracking and timelines, the seats negotiate, and the Project Head checks every requirement before shipping one integrated deliverable.
defaultPrompt: Run the marketing room on this brief.
Get the whole agency on this campaign plan.
